ruling: OpenAI's board crisis resolves with Sam Altman reinstated as CEO and the old board replaced, driven by the commercial/operational side of the org (staff, Microsoft, customers) reasserting control over the safety-board faction that ousted him.
because: Six of seven minutes converge on this outcome, but attention-substrate, ai-pressure, ai-lab-revealed-priorities, and lab-moves all lean on the same underlying premise — that operational/commercial leverage (staff loyalty, Microsoft's backing, customer dependence) outweighs the old board's formal authority — merely relabeling it as 'observability pooling,' 'operational leverage,' or 'positioning dominance.' Only pressure-model and ai-option-space argued a materially different claim (a product/pricing counter-move), and pressure-model's own round-2 defense conceded its claim was about a separate, less-dominant axis than the leadership resolution the other four were describing.
strongest_minute: attention-substrate — it specifies a falsifiable mechanism (observability recongealing around Altman before the old board could consolidate an alternative center) rather than just asserting leverage wins, giving it more predictive content than the other reinstatement arguments.
weakest_minute: ai-option-space — its claim (DevDay platform lead) was largely orthogonal to the actual Nov 17 event, and by round 2 it was already conceding its 'lead' was just one reactive round in pressure-model's cycle rather than a standalone claim.
shared_assumption: That commercial/operational control (staff, Microsoft, customers) necessarily overrides formal board/governance authority in a leverage conflict — none of the four convergent minutes independently argued why observability, operations, and revealed-priorities all cash out the same way rather than being three separate hypotheses.
unresolved: Whether the reinstatement happened because of a specific mechanism (observability pooling, operational leverage, or revealed prioritization) or simply because Microsoft and staff exerted brute commercial pressure — the minutes never adjudicate between these framings, only restate the same prediction under different vocabulary.
